President Jimmy Carter and First Lady Rosalynn Carter holding hands on stage at their inaugural ball. The ball was held on January 20, 1977, as part of the festivities following President Carter's inauguration.

Credit: Jimmy Carter Presidential Library and Museum/NARA

First Lady Rosalynn Carter at a podium in the East Room. President Carter appears on her right.

Credit: Jimmy Carter Presidential Library and Museum/NARA

First Lady Rosalynn Carter welcomes a group of sightseers in the Blue Room during a White House tour. Mrs. Carter often made surprise appearances during tours.

Credit: White House Historical Association

First Lady Rosalynn Carter greeting citizens during a stop at Prairie du Chien, Wisconsin during her tour down the Mississippi River. Accompanied by President Jimmy Carter and their daughter, Amy, Mrs. Carter rode the riverboat Delta Queen down a 659-mile stretch of the Mississippi River, pausing at four rallies along the way to garner support for the president's environmental policy.

Credit: Jimmy Carter Presidential Library and Museum/NARA
